title: 好欸拍手
brief: Single silver gray bob Xingtong, crossed clips and sailor collar. Little knee dip, joyful hands clearly apart in front of chest, accelerate palms together, single clean contact on centerline, separate, soft rebound of short hair. Tight stable half-body.

board.title: 好欸拍手
poses: 0.00 s: Draw Xingtong waist-up with a silver gray bob, crossed clips, sailor collar, forward gaze, joyful smile, and inward-facing palms 24 cm apart before her chest; begin a tiny knee dip.
0.65 s: Lower her torso slightly through the knee dip, keeping both hands fully visible and apart; let the bob tips lag upward.
1.20 s: Deepen the small dip, brighten her open smile, and spread her palms to 28 cm apart at chest height.
1.60 s: Begin rising and bring her palms inward to a 20 cm gap, keeping fingers relaxed and wrists aligned.
1.78 s: Rise farther and accelerate both palms inward to a 14 cm gap; trail the bob tips slightly downward.
1.90 s: Make one clean palm-to-palm contact on the chest centerline, with aligned fingers, visible wrists, and a delighted expression.
2.15 s: Separate both palms to a 12 cm gap, soften the elbows, and let the short hair bounce gently upward.
3.20 s: Open the hands to a 24 cm gap while settling upright; let the bob tips rebound softly downward.
4.45 s: Settle the bob and hold the hands 22 cm apart, with the torso slightly higher than pose one, ready to ease into its dip.
board.continuity: Maintain a fixed tight half-body view throughout the 4.70-second loop, consistent clips, collar, forward gaze and visible empty hands, one clap, and a smooth seam between distinct adjacent poses nine and one.
